versions.changelog:
Initial release of order-auto-entry—an out-of-the-box automated purchase order review solution for Feishu teams.

- Enables automatic extraction, review, and entry of local or Feishu email purchase order attachments via Laiye ADP, with results written to Feishu Base.
- Supports both Laiye ADP CLI and cloud API modes (auto-detects optimal use).
- Includes workspace auto-initialization: creates Base, tables, audit dashboard, demo data, and reviewer notifications via interactive Feishu card messages.
- One-stop order tracking: automatically processes new orders, uploads source files, highlights exceptions (item match, price, currency, new customers) for reviewers, and avoids duplicate processing.
- Demo data and documentation included for quick adoption and scenario demonstration.
